item.title: Tesla To Invest USD 2 Billion in xAI and Discontinue Model S and X To Pivot Toward Autonomous Future
item.description: Tesla is shifting its focus from traditional EVs to AI and robotics, investing USD 2 billion in Elon Musk’s xAI. The company will discontinue Model S and Model X by mid-2026 to retool factories for Cybercab robotaxis and Optimus humanoid robots. Tesla also reported rising energy segment revenue despite a 2025 net income drop.

item.title: Red Aurora Over Ladakh: Why Northern Lights Seen in Hanle Signal a Growing Solar Threat
item.description: The night sky over Hanle, Ladakh, is usually a canvas of deep sapphire, punctuated only by the distant glow of galaxies. But on the nights of January 19 and 20, that darkness was pierced by an eerie, blood-red glow that left scientists and skywatchers stunned.

item.title: Sadhvi Prem Baisa Found Dead in Jodhpur Months After Viral Video Case, Suicide Note Raises Fresh Questions
item.description: Sadhvi Prem Baisa, a well-known religious storyteller from Rajasthan, was found dead under suspicious circumstances at her ashram in Jodhpur on Wednesday evening. Nearly four hours after her death, a purported suicide note surfaced on social media, linking her emotional distress to a blackmail and defamation case that began six months ago.

item.title: Redmi Note 15 Pro Plus 5G Price, Specifications and Features Revealed
item.description: Xiaomi has launched the Redmi Note 15 Pro+ 5G in India today, featuring a durable design with Corning Gorilla Glass Victus 2, IP66/IP68/IP69K ratings, and 2.5-metre drop resistance. It packs a Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset, 200MP camera, 6,500mAh battery with 100W fast charging, and starts at INR 37,999, going on sale February 4.

item.title: How to Merge 2 PF Accounts? Know If Your Provident Fund Withdrawal Is Taxable
item.description: Managing multiple Provident Fund accounts has become a common challenge for salaried employees who switch jobs frequently. In many cases, a new employer allots a fresh Universal Account Number even though one already exists. Financial experts and recent clarifications stress that merging these accounts is not just about convenience but also about protecting tax benefits on PF withdrawals.

item.title: OnlyFans Creator Sophie Rain Claims USD 101 Million Earnings, Shares Dashboard Proof on Social Media (View Post)
item.description: OnlyFans creator Sophie Rain has claimed she earned over USD 101 million on the platform and shared a screen recording of her dashboard to address online doubts. Calling it her final response to scepticism, Rain said she has 'no reason to lie'. The post triggered mixed reactions, with users debating authenticity and celebrating the milestone.

item.title: Mirjana Pajković Snimak: The Story Behind the Trending Searches and Video Leak Scandal Shaking Montenegro
item.description: In January 2026, Montenegro’s human rights director Mirjana Pajković and presidential advisor Dejan Vukšić resigned following the leak of explicit private videos. Pajković alleges 'revenge p*rn' and blackmail, while Vukšić claims phone theft. The scandal has caused a massive spike in searches for 'Mirjana Pajković snimak'.
